cues.en: Did you get it running?
cues.zh: 成功執行了嗎？

cues.en: I hope so.
cues.zh: 希望有。

cues.en: Really, a lot of what you do in the real world is trying to get algorithms you read about up and running within the confines of your own development environment.
cues.zh: 真實工作中，很多時間，就是把讀到的演算法，在自己的開發環境限制下，設法跑起來。

cues.en: So I assure you, this exercise wasn't just busy work.
cues.zh: 所以，保證這不只是無意義作業。

cues.en: It's a taste of what you can expect to be doing within an industry job.
cues.zh: 是業界工作的一點體驗。

cues.en: And in the real world, this would be just the beginning.
cues.zh: 真實世界，這只是開始。

cues.en: The next step would be to integrate it into whatever systems actually provide data and produce recommendations within your organization so you can actually test it in a real world setting.
cues.zh: 下一步，要整合到組織實際提供資料、產生推薦的系統，才能在真實環境測試。

cues.en: I should also remind you that just because code is on GitHub doesn't mean that it's free for you to use however you wish.
cues.zh: 也提醒，程式放在 GitHub，不代表能隨意免費使用。

cues.en: I wouldn't just take this code and put it into a commercial system without making sure that it was offered under a license that allows for that.
cues.zh: 我不會沒確認授權允許，就直接拿來放商業系統。

cues.en: If it isn't, then all you can do is experiment with it and learn from it.
cues.zh: 不允許，就只能實驗、學習。

cues.en: But your own implementation in a production system would have to be rewritten from scratch.
cues.zh: 正式系統自己的實作，得從零重寫。

cues.en: Or better yet, offer the guy who wrote the code you want to use a job.
cues.zh: 或者更好，直接聘用作者。

cues.en: Anyhow, let's take a quick look at the modifications I made and see it run.
cues.zh: 總之，快速看我做的修改，再執行。

cues.en: So if you decompress the zip file from the URL in the previous slide, you'll get my adaptation of the GRU4Rec that works with MovieLens 100K data set, and with the latest version of Python.
cues.zh: 解壓前張投影片網址的 ZIP，就有我的 GRU4Rec 改版，能配合 MovieLens 100K，以及最新 Python。

cues.en: Let's take a step back first and think about what this code is actually doing.
cues.zh: 先退一步，想想程式做什麼。

cues.en: GRU4Rec applies a recurrent neural network to session-based clickstream data and tries to recommend things you're likely to click on next.
cues.zh: GRU4Rec 將 RNN 用於工作階段點擊流，推薦接下來可能點的項目。

cues.en: But the MovieLens data isn't really clickstream data.
cues.zh: 但 MovieLens，不是真正點擊流。

cues.en: We're just pretending it is for our purposes.
cues.zh: 我們只是為了用途，假裝是。

cues.en: The ratings data in MovieLens includes timestamps, so we actually can order ratings from a given user into a sequence, and pretend that the ratings are actually click events
cues.zh: MovieLens 評分有時間戳記，因此能把某位使用者評分排成序列，假裝評分是點擊事件，

cues.en: and not explicit ratings.
cues.zh: 不是明確評分。

cues.en: As we'll see, the algorithm still works surprisingly well, even though the data isn't really what the algorithm envisioned working with.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到，即使資料不是原設計目標，演算法仍出乎意料有效。

cues.en: It helps that the MovieLens data set only includes users who rated a large number of items, so every user has a fair amount of fake clickstream data for the algorithm to work with.
cues.zh: MovieLens 只包含評分很多項目的人，因此每人都有相當多假點擊流，供演算法使用，這有幫助。

cues.en: Anyhow, the first thing you might have to do is install the pandas and scikit-learn packages into your RecSys environment in Anaconda.
cues.zh: 總之，可能先要在 Anaconda 的 RecSys 環境，安裝 pandas、scikit-learn。

cues.en: If you skipped the introduction to deep learning section, you might not have done that already, so you may need to go to environments, select the RecSys environment,
cues.zh: 如果跳過深度學習入門，可能沒做，前往 Environments，選 RecSys，

cues.en: and once that loads up...
cues.zh: 等載入……

cues.en: What you need to do is go to not installed, search for pandas; I've already installed it, so it's not appearing in my list, but if it's in your list, you'd wanna check that off
cues.zh: 選 Not installed，搜尋 pandas。我已安裝，所以清單沒出現；如果你有，勾選，

cues.en: and then hit the apply button to kick off the installation of that package.
cues.zh: 再按 Apply，啟動套件安裝。

cues.en: When that's done, you also need scikit-learn, which would be scikit-learn like that, again for me its already installed, but if you see that as an option here,
cues.zh: 完成後，也需要 scikit-learn，像這樣。我已裝好，但如果看到選項，

cues.en: check it off and then hit apply to install that as well.
cues.zh: 勾選，再按 Apply。

cues.en: Once you have both pandas and scikit-learn installed, you can go back to home and kick off Spider.
cues.zh: 兩者裝好後，回 Home，啟動 Spyder。

cues.en: Let's open up everything.
cues.zh: 全部開啟。

cues.en: The next order of business was porting everything from Python 2.7.
cues.zh: 接著，從 Python 2.7 移植。

cues.en: For the most part, this was straightforward, but the real lesson here is that Google is your friend.
cues.zh: 大部分直接，但真正的教訓，是 Google 是好幫手。

cues.en: I didn't cover all the specific ways in which Python 3 differs from Python 2.7 in this course, but you simply can't expect to be given step-by-step instructions in how to solve
cues.zh: 課程沒介紹 Python 3 與 2.7 的所有差異，但技術領域每個問題，不能期待都有人提供

cues.en: every problem you face in the technical field.
cues.zh: 逐步解法。

cues.en: Systems are too complex, and they change too often for you to have a cookbook to solve every problem.
cues.zh: 系統太複雜、變化太頻繁，不可能每個問題都有食譜。

cues.en: When you run into a weird compilation error, you have to look up whatever command didn't compile under Python 3, and look up what changed from Python 2.7 regarding it.
cues.zh: 遇到奇怪編譯錯誤，就查哪個命令在 Python 3 無法編譯，再查與 Python 2.7 相比，改了什麼。

cues.en: Part of the point of this exercise was to force you to do that, and be resourceful in finding information on your own when you need it.
cues.zh: 練習部分目的，就是逼你這樣做，需要時，懂得自行找資訊。

cues.en: I firmly believe that resourcefulness and perseverance are two qualities that are most important to a good software developer.
cues.zh: 我深信，善用資源與毅力，是好軟體開發者最重要的兩項特質。

cues.en: For example, if we take a look at model.py here, one specific issue is that the original code used the X-range function a lot.
cues.zh: 例如 model.py，具體問題是，原程式大量用 xrange。

cues.en: I had to search for every occurrence of X-range and replace it with range.
cues.zh: 必須搜尋每個 xrange，換成 range。

cues.en: For example, here on line 113...
cues.zh: 例如第 113 行，

cues.en: and down here on line 182.
cues.zh: 以及下面第 182 行。

cues.en: I also had to replace the sort command with sort values throughout the code.
cues.zh: 也必須將整份程式的 sort，換成 sort_values。

cues.en: For example, here on line 169.
cues.zh: 例如第 169 行。

cues.en: Let's go to main.py.
cues.zh: 到 main.py。

cues.en: The next order of business was adapting the code to the ratings data we have at hand with the MovieLens 100K data.
cues.zh: 下一件事，是讓程式適用手上的 MovieLens 100K 評分資料。

cues.en: Starting at line 17, you can see that the original code had separate train and test data files that contained retail click data from the RecSys challenge 2015 data set.
cues.zh: 第 17 行起，能看到原程式有獨立訓練與測試檔，包含 RecSys Challenge 2015 的零售點擊資料。

cues.en: We don't have separate train and test files for MovieLens, so I just redirected the training data file to my ratings.csv file for MovieLens instead and got rid of the test file path.
cues.zh: MovieLens 沒有獨立訓練／測試檔，所以把訓練路徑，改到 MovieLens 的 ratings.csv，移除測試檔路徑。

cues.en: Obviously, this path will be different for you, depending on where you stored it on your system.
cues.zh: 顯然，你的路徑，依儲存位置而不同。

cues.en: Skipping down to line 62, I load up our training data, telling it about the column name for its item identifiers in the process, so we can make sure its in the type the code expects,
cues.zh: 跳到第 62 行，載入訓練資料，告訴它項目識別欄名稱，確保符合預期型別，

cues.en: that I split it into train and test data sets by just splitting off all of the ratings after row 90,000 and making that the test or validation data.
cues.zh: 再把第 90,000 列之後的評分切出來，當測試或驗證資料。

cues.en: Skipping back up to line 20,
cues.zh: 跳回第 20 行，

cues.en: the Args function also had to be modified with the column names in my data set, so the session key, item key, and time key all had to be changed to reflect the data files we have.
cues.zh: Args 也要改資料欄名，因此 session_key、item_key、time_key，都要配合資料檔。

cues.en: Unfortunately, these variables aren't always used in the rest of the code, so there are a few other places where the column names had to be changed throughout the code as well.
cues.zh: 很遺憾，其餘程式不一定都使用這些變數，所以其他幾處欄名，也得一起改。

cues.en: While testing things out, I learned the hard way that you really need to run it on a fresh kernel every time.
cues.zh: 測試時，我吃過苦頭，才知道每次真的要用全新核心。

cues.en: Closing out the console window and allowing a new one to appear between each run does the trick.
cues.zh: 關閉主控台，讓下次出現新的，就能做到。

cues.en: The errors you receive make absolutely no sense if you don't do this.
cues.zh: 不做的話，錯誤訊息完全沒意義。

cues.en: Also, you'll find that the code stores state data in a checkpoint and pycache folder inside your project.
cues.zh: 另外，專案 checkpoint 與 pycache 資料夾，會存狀態。

cues.en: When all else fails, you can try deleting these folders to force it to start from a clean slate instead of restoring a previously-built model.
cues.zh: 其他都沒用時，可以試著刪除這些資料夾，強迫重新開始，而不是還原舊模型。

cues.en: Overall though, it wasn't too hard to get it up and running, and it's certainly a quicker way to start experimenting with GRU4Rec than trying to write it yourself from the ground up.
cues.zh: 整體而言，跑起來不難，也絕對比從零寫，更快開始 GRU4Rec 實驗。

cues.en: Let's run it. It goes pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 執行看看，相當快。

cues.en: First, we'll just run it with the default parameters to actually train the model, let that run for a few minutes.
cues.zh: 先用預設參數訓練模型，跑幾分鐘。

cues.en: Now the model is trained.
cues.zh: 現在模型訓練好了。

cues.en: Remember to close out your console in between runs, and now we'll run a testing repass on it.
cues.zh: 記得，每次之間關主控台，接著做測試輪次。

cues.en: To do that, we just set the train parameter to zero, and hit save, and run that.
cues.zh: 將 train 參數設為零，儲存，再執行。

cues.en: Unfortunately, the output isn't terribly interesting.
cues.zh: 很可惜，輸出沒太多意思。

cues.en: We don't get to see any examples of actual recommendations, only the measurements of the final results.
cues.zh: 看不到實際推薦範例，只有最後衡量指標。

cues.en: But to be fair, it would be hard to subjectively evaluate the results given that we're using a data set that wasn't really intended for this sort of thing to begin with.
cues.zh: 但公平地說，資料集原本就不是為這用途設計，主觀評估結果也很難。

cues.en: They give us a result for recall@20.
cues.zh: 它提供 recall@20。

cues.en: This is basically hit rate, looking at the top 20 results, so I like that they're focusing on hit rate as a metric.
cues.zh: 基本上就是看前 20 個結果的命中率，所以我喜歡它以命中率為指標。

cues.en: The number is small, but at least it's not zero, and given the small size of our data set and the fact that it isn't really session-based data to begin with, I think it's impressive that it's as high as it is.
cues.zh: 數字小，但至少不是零；考量資料小、也不是真正工作階段資料，我覺得能這麼高，很厲害。

cues.en: In the paper, scores as high as 0.66 were achieved, which is pretty darn amazing.
cues.zh: 論文最高達到 0.66，相當驚人。

cues.en: They were able to accurately predict a click within their top 20 results two-thirds of the time.
cues.zh: 前 20 個結果，約三分之二情況，能正確預測點擊。

cues.en: MRR@20 is what we've called ARHR in this course.
cues.zh: MRR@20，就是本課程稱為 ARHR 的東西。

cues.en: It stands for Mean Reciprocal Rank looking at the top 20 results, which is just another way of saying Average Reciprocal Hit Rank.
cues.zh: 代表前 20 項的平均倒數排名，也就是另一種說法的平均倒數命中排名。

cues.en: In the paper, this score was as high as 0.39.
cues.zh: 論文這個分數，最高 0.39。

cues.en: It's worth noting, however, that item-based KNN also produced impressive results.
cues.zh: 不過，項目式 KNN，也有很厲害的結果。

cues.en: So the difference between what we're seeing in the paper and what we're seeing on our desktop has more to do with the data we're using to train and test the algorithm with than anything.
cues.zh: 因此，論文與桌機結果的差異，主要還是用來訓練、測試演算法的資料。
